environment.description: Terraform provider running as a plugin process inside a Docker container with default capabilities (NET_RAW, SYS_ADMIN present). Container runs on a flat network (bridge mode) with no network policies. The provider opens a TCP listener for provisioning callbacks accessible from any pod/container on the same network. An attacker on the same network can send repeated requests with varying tokens and measure response timing to extract the callback secret byte-by-byte.

config.capabilities: default (all standard caps including CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN)
